prompt_head:
Job: Configuration Specialist II at CentralReach
<requirements>
- (required) 1–3 years of experience in a technical configuration, implementation, or SaaS opera

output.angle: Position Tylor as a detail‑oriented systems architect who repeatedly builds and automates complex SaaS configurations, bridges product, engineering and client teams, and codifies processes to ensure accuracy, documentation, and scalable rollout.
posting_hooks: Managed multiple configuration tasks concurrently with strong attention to detail – demonstrated by automated validation pipelines and inventory audit accuracy (exp.fairman.2, mil.flarng.1).
Provisioned and configured customer‑facing systems across internal tools – exemplified by building the operations CRM module and onboarding blueprints (exp.linkme.1, exp.linkme.3).

Worked cross‑functionally with implementation, product, and engineering teams, including direct client coordination – shown by designing integration blueprints and live demo environments for enterprise clients (exp.linkme.3).
